read_dir.help_text: Absolute path to a directory containing reads (mandatory)

ref.help_text: Absolute path to a reference reference DNA sequence fasta (mandatory)

program.help_text: Mapping program you wish to include: BWA|SSAHA|SMALT

human.help_text: Optimise SMALT for mapping against human genome

maxinsertsize.help_text: Maximum insert size for paired-end reads (SMALT/SSAHA only)

mininsertsize.help_text: Minimum insert size for paired-end reads (SMALT/SSAHA only)

ssahaquality.help_text: Minimum Phred base quality score (SSAHA only)

allow_multimapping.help_text: Map all reads, including repeats (even ambiguous mappings). Default is false to exclude multi-mapping reads. (SMALT only)

nomapid.help_text: Minimum identity threshold, as a float, for mapping to be reported (SMALT only)

filter.help_text: Filtering mode for bam file (1=No filter, 2=remove unmapped, 3=properly paired only, 4=split mapped/unmapped, 5=split properly paired/unpaired)

prior.help_text: Sets the prior probability that a site is non-reference for variant calling, higher values increase sensitivity to rare variants (optional)

BAQ.help_text: Use samtools base alignment quality option (BAQ) (optional)

indels.help_text: Include small indels in pseudosequence alignment (optional)

depth.help_text: Minimum number of reads matching SNP (optional)

stranddepth.help_text: Minimum number of reads matching SNP per strand (optional)

bootstrap.help_text: Number of bootstrap replicates for RAxML, 0=No bootstrap (optional)
